verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is a bare "AI & Automation" heading on the features page. Nothing shows AI screening or matching candidates against a role, and nothing documents how such AI works or what safeguards apply to automated decisions. Boolean search and the audit logs are adjacent features and do not count toward this story, so the verdict is none.
